content: I am a Ph.D. student at Department of Computer Science, University of Wisconsin-Madison. I am fortunate to be advised by Prof. Andrea Arpaci-Dusseau and Prof. Remzi Arpaci-Dusseau, as a member of The ADvanced Systems Laboratory (ADSL). My current research interest lies in the field of improving the caching mechanism for the modern storage hierarchy consisting of Persistent Memory and Ultra-fast SSD.
